title: spec near-miss suggester: the max(2, len/3) rename budget is copied in four more spec files, so short or retired keys still get unrelated guesses (e.g. defaultSort → defaults) (follow-up to #33345)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding from the #33345 os-dev report (comment 7003316873), routed by the L1-a ACCEPT of PR #35397 (7004079215, out of scope) as one card nested under #33345. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade (L1 suggests p3).

## What the author sees

PR #35397 fixed the unknown-key suggester in `packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts`: a key of 5 characters or fewer is offered a rename only at one edit (adjacent swap counted as one), so `aria` is no longer answered `areas`. The same `max(2, len/3)` budget is copied in four other places that PR does not touch, so those doors still misguess:

- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (`suggestKey`)
- `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`
- `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts`
- `packages/spec/src/data/default-value-shape.ts`

Also: the retired form key `defaultSort` is answered "Did you mean `defaultSort` → `defaults`?" (distance 3, budget 3). Measured through the schema and flattener only, not through a public door.

## Fix direction

One shared budget rule (the one #35397 settled), used by every suggester; pins at each door. A retired key should get its prescription, not a rename guess.

## Nits that may ride along

- The header of `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-packaged-action-permission-refusal.test.ts` and the retired checklist item `access-security.packaged-permission-set-lifecycle` still describe the retired data-door clone route `POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set`. Comment and retired-item text only.

Dedupe: issue search `rename budget suggester`, `did you mean retired key defaultSort`, `near-miss suggester short key` → only #33345.
